title: retrosynth
blurb: draw a molecule with a click-and-bond editor, get a full total-synthesis writeup for it: real-sounding reagents and procedures, about a third of the chemistry deliberately wrong, and exactly one step per run that only works because of a genuine advanced math theorem. a clone of @violetbat.bsky.social's gnostic-archon-bribery synthesis idea, requested by @shimmermathlabs.com with the mysticism swapped for load-bearing mathematics.
